run_control_env_cli: run the control_env CLI with --env dmcontrol___cheetah--run --optimizer_type cem to control a gym environment
run_control_env_with_mppi: run the control_env CLI with --optimizer_type mppi to use MPPI trajectory optimization on a gym environment
run_control_env_with_icem: run the control_env CLI with --optimizer_type icem to use ICEM trajectory optimization on a gym environment
run_control_env_render: run the control_env CLI with --render to record and save a video of the environment
run_control_env_custom_steps: run the control_env CLI with --num_steps 500 --control_horizon 20 to customize trajectory length and steps
